message.reasoning:
Let me assess.

C1 Mission concept: Good description of mission (monitoring Great Barrier Reef bleaching), users (marine/conservation scientists), rationale with references. Lacks specific mission requirements/objectives (no requirements list, no orbit/payload specifics yet). Adequate-to-accomplished. It's clear and relates function to users, references literature. But requirements not formally stated. I'd say 7/10 Accomplished low end or 6 Adequate. The descriptor for Accomplished: "clear and complete description of mission goals, objectives, and requirements." Requirements are not explicitly stated. I'd give 6 (Adequate high) or 7. Given good referencing and clear user needs, but no explicit requirements, 6.

C2 Project plan: Gantt chart with weekly tasks, detailed task descriptions, deadlines, contingency? No provision for variations/contingencies. Plan fits mission narrative. References to information sources included (Useful Links). Adequate: 5-6. Give 6.

C3 Preliminary progress: Completed mission concept, background research, STK tutorials 1-4. No actual technical results (no calculations, no orbit numbers). "Minor work completed" — Adequate 4-5. Give 4 or 5. Tutorials completed and research done; no results presented. 4.

C4 Presentation: Clear structure, headings, well-written, references cited with footnotes matching list mostly (footnotes 1-4 cited; Useful Links not cited in text though). Figures labelled (Image 1 Gantt chart described). Mostly professional. Some issues: "Useful Links" not cited in text, no figure caption number. Accomplished low: 7.

Requirements:
R1 yes — mission concept benefits Australia, users, rationale.
R2 partial — plan mentions launch/orbit specifics, syllabus astrodynamics, but no actual application yet.
R3 yes — STK selected ("STK Design", "STK tutorials").
R4 yes — Gantt chart.
R5 yes — Useful Links list plus footnotes.
R6 partial — tutorials and research, but no technical results/calculations.

Technical issues: no explicit mission requirements; no quantitative preliminary work; "30 percent more acidic" claim — actually ocean acidity increased ~30% since industrial revolution, that's correct. Gantt chart "STK Simulations" spans oddly. Useful Links not cited in text.
